perspective:
From Bradley Ochoa’s available perspective:

- He works at a marketing firm as a salesperson; Katherine Lasiloo is the marketing manager and colleague. They have a professional relationship that has sometimes been strained by differing views on sales and marketing strategies.
- In a meeting, Bradley brought data and charts supporting traditional sales techniques. He believed core sales would benefit from traditional methods and felt those proven methods were being sidelined. He expressed this to Katherine.
- He heard Katherine acknowledge his point but say the market is evolving and digital outreach has potential. She asked how he reconciled his data with increasing online engagement.
- Bradley told Katherine he was not suggesting abandoning digital marketing, but was frustrated by traditional methods being overlooked. Katherine said the goal was balance and proposed analyzing the data together to integrate both approaches.
- After the meeting, Katherine shared recent digital campaign success stories showing significantly boosted engagement and sales. Bradley asked how those strategies were developed.
- Katherine told him it involved targeting the right audience with the right message, and offered to walk him through the analytics and decision-making process. Bradley admitted he had doubted moving away from traditional methods but now wanted to understand digital more. Katherine welcomed his openness, said they should adapt to market trends, and suggested diving deeper into the data.
- Bradley proposed a joint strategy meeting to combine traditional and digital approaches. Katherine agreed and said they should schedule a time to brainstorm and outline next steps. Bradley felt hopeful and appreciated her willingness to collaborate.
- After the joint meeting, Bradley prepared a draft presentation for the board integrating both their ideas, working overtime and feeling excited. Katherine reviewed it and told him it looked comprehensive, well thought out, and showed his hard work. Bradley said he was convinced the integrated approach would set them apart and wanted to make sure the presentation succeeded. Katherine agreed they should go through it once more and fine-tune it.
- Following the presentation and implementation of the new strategy, Bradley thanked Katherine, said he had learned a lot, and felt grateful for his growth through their collaboration. Katherine said it had been a pleasure and that his openness made the partnership successful.
- Bradley proposed regular strategy sessions to continue collaborating. Katherine agreed, saying it would keep them on top of their work and market trends.
